question: Choose the suitable option to complete the sentence.(2)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Transforms**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in the passage is: *"...knowledge is not the passive reception of an external truth but an active process in which consciousness shapes and ______ (2) its own reality."*
 
• The verb must indicate the process of changing or creating reality through active participation of consciousness.
 
• "**Transforms**" (परिवर्तित करता है) means to change something significantly or completely, which fits perfectly with the philosophical context of shaping reality.
 
• Other options do not fit logically: **Transports** means carrying from one place to another, **Interrupts** means stopping something temporarily, and **Disabuses** means freeing someone from a false idea.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1) Transforms**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Transports (परिवहन करता है)** – To carry something or someone from one place to another.

 **Example:** The bus transports hundreds of passengers daily.
 
• **Interrupts (बाधित करता है)** – To stop or hinder something temporarily.

 **Example:** The loud noise interrupts our discussion.
 
• **Disabuses (भ्रम से मुक्त करता है)** – To persuade someone that a belief or idea is wrong.

 **Example:** The teacher disabuses students of the notion that history is boring.
